content: Hoittor duizonore toboligot defeṛaiye

Hiyar bade Malik Isaye aro oinno hoittor duizonor mainšore basona goijje. Ar Isa nize ze ze šohor ba fara okkolot zaibolla ereda goijje, he šomosto zaga edde šohorot hiba zaibar age duizon duizon gori hitarare defeṛaiye.
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Hãsa, dán beši foille kintu dán daoya manuš hom. Etolla danor malikor hãse foriyad goro zene malike hibar dán daibolla manuš faṭai de.
Tũwara zo! Ãi tũwarare sool hisabe genḍa bagor okkolor butore defeṛair.
Ṭiyar beg, hoilla ba ṭengor šendal fũwati no loiyo, edde fõtot honokiyor loi mulot oibolla no tiyaiyo.
"Kintu tũwara ze górot goliba, heṛe tũwara foila hoiba, 'Ei górot šanti aiyok.'
Zodi heṛe šantir manuš take henoile tũwarar šanti hitar uwore ziraibo. Ar zodi hendilla honokiye no take hentoile tũwarar šanti tũwarar hãse firi aibo.
Ar he górot taikko edde hitara zin há fiya gorito de hin haiyo, kiyollahoile ze ham gore hite beton faibar laikka. Ek gór sari ar ek górot no zaiyogoi.
"Zodi hono farat zo edde heṛeiyar manuš okkole tũwarare gose toile hitara tũwarare zin de hin haiyo!
He farar biyaraimma okkolore aram goijjo edde hoiba, 'Allar raijjo tũwarar hãse aišše.'
Kintu zodi hono farat zo edde heṛiyar mainše tũwarare no gose, he farar rasta rasta zai en hoiba,
'Tũwarar farar ze dul ãrar ṭengot boijje hin o ãra zari felailam, tarfore o tũwara zani rako ze Allar raijjo hãse aišše.'
Ãi tũwarare hoir, bisaror din he farattuwaro Súdum šohoror doša šowa zaibo.

"Korasin šohor tor bifod! Betsaida šohor tor bifod! Ze šob keramot tũwarar butore gora oiye, hin okkol zodi Tiros edde Sidon šohorot gora oito, toile hitara bout din age salar šoṭ findi saiyot boi gunattu mon firaito.
Kintu bisaror din tũwarar došattuwaro Tiros edde Sidon šohoror doša šowa zaibo.
Ar tui Kofornahum šohor, tũi bole ki asman uwore uṛibi? Honodin oi no fare, tore meṛir nise fatalfurot feli diya oibo!
"Zara tũwarar hota fune hitara ãr hota fune. Zara tũwarare hela gore, hitara ãre hela gore. Kintu zara ãre hela gore, hitara ãre ze defeṛaiye hibare hela gore."

content: He hoittor duizon kušir sãte firi aišše
He hoittor duizon ummote kušir sãte firi aišše edde hodde: "Malik, õnor nam dorile bod ruh okkole foijjonto ãrar hota fune!"
Toi Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi Šoitanore asmanottu bizoli somkefana gori nise foredde dekki.
So, ãi tũwarare haf edde bissure ṭenge fiši maribolla edde dušmon Šoitanor har šokti loi ziti faribolla šokti diyi. Hono kissuye tũwarare hoti gori no faribo.
Kintu bod ruhuye tũwarar hota fune boli kuši no goijjo bolke behostot tũwarar nam leka oiye boli kuši goro."

content: Hetunot Isaye Pak Ruhur kušiye ullaš oi hodde,

content.text: "Ya Baf, tũi asman edde duniyair malik, ãi tũware šukuriya zanai, kiyollahoile ei hota okkol tũi giyani edde buddiman okkolottu lukairaki masum gura fuwaindor hãse forhaš goijjo. Oi, Baf, iyan tũwar bala issa.
"Ãr Bafe ãr hatot hár kissu diye. Baf sara ar honokiye no zane Fuwa honnuwade hiyan, ar Fuwa sara honokiye no zane Baf honnuwade hiyan. Ar Fuwaye zar hãse Bafore forhaš goitto sa šude hite zane."

content: Toi hitara zehon ekela oiye, hibaye hitarar mikka firiyore hodde,

content.text: "Rahamot ok he suk okkolor uwore, tũwara dekodde hin zara deker.
Ãi tũwarare hoir: Tũwara dekorde hin bout nobi okkole edde badša okkole saito issa goijje kintu saibolla no fa, ar funito issa goijje kintu funito no fa."

content: Ek Sameriyar rahamoti manušor kahani
Ar so, ekzon dórmiyo aleme Isare forikka gori saibolla hibar hãse aiyore hodde, "Huzur, akeri zibonor odihar faite ãttu ki gora foribo?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ainot ki leka ase? Heṛe hondilla foijjo?"

content: He hite hodde: "'Tũi tũwar šomosto dil, šomosto mon, šomosto foran, šomosto šokti, diyore Allah Mabudore muhabbot goro. Ar tũwar ḍen gór bam gójjare nizor zani muhabbot goro.'"
Isaye hitare hodde:

content.text: "Tũi ṭik zuwab diyo. Zodi tũi he mozin gorat tako, toi tũi o zibon faiba."

content: He aleme hitar nizor šorman basaibolla Isare abar hodde, "Bala, ãr ḍen gór bam gójja hontara?"
Zuwabe Isaye endilla hoiye:

content.text: "Ekzon manuš Zeruzalemottu fõt bai lami Zeriku šohorot zar, hen šomot hite ḍahaitor hatot foijje. Ḍahait okkole hitar findonor hoorgun kuli loi felaiye edde hitare mari ada mora abostat raki giyegoi.
Goṭona sokkore ekzon imam o he fõt bai lami aišše. Hite he manušware deki rasta fašhaṛi gilgoi.
Bade hendilla ekzon dórmogór šasiyot goroya Levi o he zagat ai manušware deki, hite o fašhaṛi giyegoi.
Tarbade Sameriya elehar ekzon manuš, zarare šomazot niroš zat hisabe gona oito, he fõt bai zaite zaite oi manušwar hãsa hãsi aišše. Hitare deki tattu doya laigge,
edde hitar ḍake zai, hitar gá okkolot tel edde ãnguror roš ḍalidi hinore bandi diye. Tarfore hitar nizor zanuwaror uwore buwai ek šoraihanat loigiye edde hitare šeba zotton goijje.
Tarfordin he Sameriyar manušwaye duiyan dinar šoraihanar menezarore diyore hodde, 'Ei manušwar adorhatir goriba, beši za kissu horos o, hin ãi abar aile šud gori diyum.'
"Ehon tũwattu ki mone o? Ei tinzonor maze hone he ḍahaitor hatot fora manušwar ḍen gór bam gójja?"

content: He aleme zuwabe hodde, "Ze manušwaye hitare ador hatir goijje hite." Toi Isaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Toile tũi o zo he mozin gorogoi."

content: Martá edde hibar boin Moriyam
Ar hitara zadde šomot Isaye hono ek farat góille, heṛe Martá name ek maya fuwaye hibar górot Isare meheman hisabe goisse.
Moriyam name ekzon hibattu boin aššil. Hibaye Malik Isar ṭengor ḍake ai boi Isar hota funer.

Kintu Martá góror harz harbare beši duwadit aššil. Hibaye hitara dunizonor hãse aiyore hodde: "Malik õne ki kissu bafi no sor ne, ãr boine ãre beggun halika ga gora diyede? Õne hibare ãre modot gori dito ho!"
Kintu malik Isaye zuwabe hodde:

content.text: "Martá! Tui bout hame duwadit edde sintat.
Kintu ekkan šude zoruri ham ase. Moriyame he hamman basi loiye, hetolla hiyan hibattu loi fela no zaibo."
